notes.title: Still working hard!
notes.content:
[p]Just letting everyone know we are hard at work on this game!  There is so much good stuff we're excited to share, but also a number of details to finish polishing.
Here are some details - 

Active Abilities - such as brand new Ice abilities like Blizzard, and many more that we'll save for a demo.[/p][p]Passive Abilities - like Mana Refund, and Shield Barrier have been implemented and are working great![/p][p][/p][p]Brand new artwork and levels.[/p][p]A new way of entering each type of themed dungeons.[/p][p][/p][p]Multiplayer improvements![/p][p][/p][p]The demo is getting very close and we're nailing down the remaining issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking forward to sharing much more in the days and weeks to come.  And, keep an eye on our X page for one-off items to be shown.[/p][p]-SuperMapleDevs[/p]
